name: paths
title: Paths
description:
A GeoPressureR `path` contains positions along a bird trajectory.

{:.alert .alert-info}
In GeoPressureR, there are 4 path types: `tag`, `most_likely`, `simulation`, and `geopressureviz`. See [`paths.type`](#type) for more details.

`path` should always be used in combination with [`staps`](/GeoLocator-DP/geopressurer/staps), joined by the composite key (`tag_id`, `stap_id`).

fields.name: tag_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the tag. Foreign key to [`tags.tag_id`](/GeoLocator-DP/core/tags#tag_id).

fields.name: type
fields.description:
One of:
 - `tag`: Created with [`tag2path()`](https://geopressure.com/GeoPressureR/reference/tag2path) from a likelihood map.
 - `most_likely`: Created with [`graph_most_likely()`](https://geopressure.com/GeoPressureR/reference/graph_most_likely.html).
 - `simulation`: Created by [`graph_simulation()`](https://geopressure.com/GeoPressureR/reference/graph_simulation).
 - `geopressureviz`: Created by [`geopressureviz()`](https://geopressure.com/GeoPressureR/reference/geopressureviz).

fields.name: stap_id
fields.description: Identifier of the stationary period. Together with [`tag_id`](#tag_id), this forms a foreign key to [`staps`](/GeoLocator-DP/geopressurer/staps) (`tag_id`, `stap_id`).

fields.name: j
fields.description: Unique identifier for each trajectory. Only useful for `paths.type='simulation'`. Integer from `1` to `nj` as defined in [`GeoPressureR::graph_simulation()`](https://geopressure.com/GeoPressureR/reference/graph_simulation).
